turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there, how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I found a laptop I like but there are two versions.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Let me guess, more memory or more storage? One has sixteen gigs of memory and the other has a bigger drive. Which do you think you'd miss more?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Someone's at the door, give me a second. Stay quiet until I'm back.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, I'm from the building office, we're checking smoke alarms today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, can you come back in an hour?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, they're gone. I'm back now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Everything okay at the door? Still weighing memory against storage on that laptop?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Memory. I always have a million browser tabs open.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then memory is the right call. You can always add an external drive later.
